I’m writing this review for those applying for a Tatkal fresh passport at Passport Seva Kendra Thane.

I applied for a Tatkal fresh passport on the official Passport Seva website on 8th April and got an appointment for 17th April at 12:45 PM. I carried all my documents including 10th, 12th, and graduation mark sheets, electricity bill, birth certificate, Aadhaar, PAN, ration card, and driving license, along with 2 self-attested photocopies of each. For safety, I also carried my parents’ Aadhaar and PAN cards.

My reporting time was 12:30 PM, but I reached by 12:15 PM. The security staff asked people with the 12:45 slot to wait separately, while earlier slots were allowed first. Even though we arrived early, we had to wait a bit, which was fair. Around our slot time, they verified the appointment message/receipt and original Aadhaar card before allowing us inside.

Once inside, before going to the token counter, you need to fill a Tatkal form (available at the xerox counter for ₹4). After filling it properly, I went to the token counter where my documents were verified and scanned, and I received my token.

The process then moved through sections A, B, and C:

* In Section A, my documents were checked and a live photo was taken.
* In Section B, the officer verified my details through DigiLocker (I highly recommend uploading your documents there in advance).
* In Section C, the officer reviewed everything and approved (granted) my file.

Within a minute, I received a message for police verification. The entire process was very smooth and efficient for Tatkal applicants. My work was completed within 1–2 hours, and the passport will be delivered via Speed Post.

Overall, I had a very good experience. 👍

featured_reviews.name: Yashvi Gavankar
featured_reviews.review_text:

One important point: before leaving the office, the security person insists you fill out the feedback form. It seems that the more feedback he collects, the better bonus he receives, so you cannot exit without completing it.

A useful tip: ensure you already have valid documents and keep your Digilocker with Aadhaar card ready on your mobile phone. This saves time and avoids last-minute hassles.

My work was completed within 30 minutes, and on the same day I received a message from my nearest police station regarding verification.

Overall, the process was smooth and efficient, though crowd management in B and C sections and the forced feedback requirement could be improved.

I submitted online application for business visa and it’s been more than 2 weeks, no updates anything from consulate. I contacted the help desk but they also don’t have information. The embassy suppose to be helping the people who seeks visa, in streamlined process, to make easier, instead we’re suffering with unknown timeline of online approval. We’re forced to relay on agency because uncertainty. Is it really required to review the application more than 2 weeks? It’s is under review. Even more. In other countries, it’s not the case, it’s hardly 3-5 working days whereas we are struck with this.
Dear management, kindly help the candidates with timeline so that he can plan accordingly

featured_reviews.name: sameer arote
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a frequent traveler to China for the past 10 years, and until now my visa applications have always been approved without issue. Unfortunately, my recent online visa application was rejected without any reason provided.

I strongly believe that applicants should be informed of the reason for rejection so that any mistakes can be avoided in future applications. The lack of clarity creates unnecessary difficulties, especially for business travelers like myself.

I currently have several important meetings scheduled during the Canton Fair, but due to the rejection, I am unable to attend. Even if I reapply, the current online verification process takes more than 15 days, which means I will likely miss this crucial event.

I respectfully request that your office improve the transparency and efficiency of the visa application process. Clear communication of rejection reasons and faster processing times would greatly benefit applicants and strengthen business relations.
